Title: IPD registration confirms successfully with numeric-only parent/religion names and special characters in ID number
Preconditions: User logged in to team40.qaaerp.com with valid credentials
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open https://team40.qaaerp.com and login (ID: team40, Password: vASPFtSh4d). 2. Go to IPD Details > IPD Registration and click New. 3. In IPD flow, create/select record with value 1234 and open Patient Registration Record. 4. Enter Father's / Husband's Name = 1234. 5. Enter Mother's Name = 1234. 6. Enter Religion = 1234. 7. In Identity Document, set Document Type = Aadhar Card. 8. Enter ID No. = 1234#$23456. 9. Open General Consent tab and check consent checkbox. 10. Click Confirm Registration.
Expected Result: System should block confirmation and display validation errors: name fields must not accept numeric-only input and ID No. must reject special characters.
Actual Result: Record was successfully confirmed (status changed to Confirmed) despite invalid numeric-only values in name/religion fields and special characters in ID No.; no blocking validation was shown.
